definitions.explanation: Something that occurs only once or is not part of a series. Used for events, jobs, broadcasts, and other activities that are not recurring.
In technical contexts, having only one engine (aircraft) or firing one shot at a time (firearms).

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a one-time part-time job.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{単発|たんぱつ}だ。
examples.english: This drama is a standalone, not a series.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧で{定期開催|ていきかいさい}になった。
examples.english: It was a one-time event, but it was well received and became a regular event.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小型機|こがたき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単発|たんぱつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{装填|そうてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This gun is single-shot and needs to be loaded one round at a time.

examples.japanese: {単発|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{双発機|そうはつき}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{燃費|ねんぴ}→燃費：18969_nenpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Single-engine planes have better fuel efficiency than twin-engine ones.

notes:
Composed of {単|たん} (single) and {発|ぱつ} (emission, shot). Sense 1 is far more common in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単発|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: one-time job
- {単発|たんぱつ}⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: standalone TV drama (not a series)
- {単発|たんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: one-off event
- {単発|たんぱつ}⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧: single-session course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧: serial, continuous — the opposite of one-time
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧: serialized — for publications
- ⟦{一回限|いっかいかぎ}り→一回限り：20533_ikkaikagiri⟧: one time only — emphasizes the limit
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧きり: only once — more emotional/emphatic
